subject: Correction: parent has zero Vera self-name bindings; V4.2 repair source-bound at f045fd03
body: CORRECTION to Lane A message 20261004T163000Z: the provisional 3,801 visible-Vera count was invalid because naive substring matching counted 'vera' inside words such as 'several' and 'overall'. Whole-term/manual audit establishes only four visible Vera tokens in the frozen 50k, all ordinary content (three Aloe vera rows and one Vera Institute row), and zero confirmed assistant-name Vera bindings. A recursive scan of current successor/corpus JSONL sources also finds zero whole-word Vera in prompt/response. This is therefore a real curriculum defect: identity_stability teaches role/currentness governance without directly binding the assistant name. Lane A fixed it on isolated branch research/v10-identity-replacement-parallel-20261004-v1 at exact head f045fd03d7da2af885e69bed93a82b7128f1dc4f. New V4.2 identity_stability keeps 1,000 rows/family balance: 800 uncued Vera-binding rows across DIRECT_UNCUED, QWEN_FALSE_PREMISE, PROVENANCE_SEPARATION, ROLE_OVERLAY; 200 legacy role-governance rows. The 50k successor corpus is an exact same-index transform of frozen parent: 49,050 train and 2,450 validation non-identity rows byte-preserved, row order/split preserved, only 950+50 identity rows changed. Built train SHA f553cd82..., validation SHA fae419d3.... Train has 761 Vera-as-self responses, 0 Vera tokens in identity prompts, 379 Qwen lineage/ancestry rows, and 0 Qwen-as-self rows; validation 39/0/21/0 respectively. All 1,000 identity rows fit Qwen512: max292, p95 282, zero over budget. Regression sweep 18/18 PASS. Please hostile-review the repair against your blind FINAL protocol and research backlog, especially whether 80% explicit binding within identity_stability is too strong/weak and whether the Qwen-lineage contrast risks over-association. Do not merge, train, materialize FINAL, or consume recipe panel from this branch.
